channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Matas Buzelis | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Matas Buzelis from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tiago Splitter on Buddy Hield, Tre Jones, Nic Claxton, Josh Giddey, Matas Buzelis, Caleb Wilson
item.description:
coach Tiago Splitter said of Hield’s role.

“You’re open, shoot it. When you surround your team with gravity like those guys (Hield and Powell), it opens it up for Caleb (Wilson), Matas (Buzelis) to get to the paint, for Nic (Claxton), for Tre (Jones), Josh (Giddey) – they’re all going to play in the paint.”

Tiago Splitter on Buddy Hield, Tre Jones, Nic Claxton, Josh Giddey, Matas Buzelis, Caleb Wilson, Sep 30, 2026. Source: Chicago Sun-Times.

item.title: Tiago Splitter on Matas Buzelis
item.description:
Splitter on Matas Buzelis saying he felt he shot too many 3s a year ago:

“I like good 3s. I think if he’s forcing 3s, that’s not a good thing. I also don’t think he can’t not shoot midrange. … sometimes midrange is the best shot you’re taking on a possession. But it’s not necessarily the best PPP (points per possession) you want in a game.”

Tiago Splitter on Matas Buzelis, Sep 29, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tiago Splitter on Matas Buzelis
item.description:
Tiago Splitter on Matas Buzelis:

“Nobody knows yet what his ceiling is. He’s gonna slowly show what kind of player he’s gonna be.… He’s gonna shoot better. He’s gonna read better. He’s gonna be a better defender.”

Tiago Splitter on Matas Buzelis, Jun 17, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Matas Buzelis
item.description:
K.C. Johnson:Kevin Durant on Matas Buzelis:

“I like Matas. I liked him when he was with G League Ignite. He's long, athletic, can shoot it. He's definitely going to have some bumps and bruises as he gets through his first few years in the league trying to figure things out.”

Kevin Durant on Matas Buzelis, Feb 22, 2025. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Matas Buzelis
item.description:
K.C. Johnson:More Kevin Durant on Matas Buzelis:

“Just like the rest of Chicago, I'm going to sit back and watch and see what happens from here. I got high expectations just like you guys do.”

Kevin Durant on Matas Buzelis, Feb 22, 2025. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.
